name: Derivative-free Pose Estimation via Feature Matching
aliases: Derivative-free pose estimation via feature matching
definition: A pipeline to estimate the 6-DoF pose of a target from a single image by rendering multiple images at sampled pose perturbations, extracting feature correspondences between the reference and rendered images, and computing a least-squares estimate for the pose using differential corrections to an initial guess.
summary: Derivative-free Pose Estimation via Feature Matching estimates 6-DoF pose by matching features between reference and rendered images, bypassing complex image formation models unlike gradient-based methods.
